description: This file defines the 'Dispatcher' class and 'ProtocolSession' class for handling protocol message dispatching, session management, and event emission in a Firefox-related project, utilizing external protocol and helper modules.

classes.name: Dispatcher
classes.description: Handles protocol message dispatching, session management, and event emission.

classes.name: ProtocolSession
classes.description: Represents a protocol session with methods for event emission and message dispatching.

methods.name: _dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the dispatcher, cleaning up connections and sessions.

methods.name: _dispatch
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, dispatching them to appropriate session methods.

methods.name: _emitEvent
methods.description: Emits an event to the connection.

methods.name: setHandler
methods.description: Sets a handler for the session.

methods.name: emitEvent
methods.description: Emits an event from the session.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches a message to the session handler.
